question: Will the strait reopen this month, yes or no?

lines.text: Iran says America's reply on reopening the Strait of Hormuz is insufficient.
lines.note: Reuters via ThePrint and The New Arab, 11 Oct 2026: Rezaei via state media

lines.text: Security chief Mohsen Rezaei told state media Washington must clarify its position.
lines.note: Rezaei, Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council: Washington needs to clarify points that remain unclear

lines.text: His words: they have accepted some of our conditions, while others remain unclear.
lines.note: The New Arab (Reuters): 'In their response, they have accepted some of our conditions, while others remain unclear.'

scene.quote: They have accepted some of our conditions, while others remain unclear.

lines.text: He says the strait stays shut to the US, with no talks, until the conditions are met.
lines.note: Rezaei: Iran 'clearly stated that the Strait of Hormuz would not be opened to them, and no negotiations would take place, until these conditions are met.'

lines: until terms are met, Iran says

lines.text: Iran is no longer responding to the Americans, he says.
lines.note: Rezaei: Iran is 'no longer in the process of responding to the Americans.' (paraphrased in speech, not shown as a quote)

lines.text: Iran's plan, set out at the UN, has seven conditions.
lines.note: Reuters: seven-condition proposal presented at the UN General Assembly

lines.text: If they are met, Iran says shipping could return within seven days.
lines.note: Reuters: the Strait could reopen and normal maritime passage be restored within seven days if the conditions were met

lines.text: America replied via mediators in Qatar. The White House has not commented.
lines.note: Reuters: US replied via Qatari intermediaries; the White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment

lines.text: At sea, Britain's UKMTO says a projectile struck a tanker in the strait on Sunday.
lines.note: Al Jazeera, 11 Oct: UKMTO said an unidentified projectile struck an outbound tanker in the strait on Sunday afternoon

lines.text: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say a supertanker hit a mine on an unauthorised route.
lines.note: Al Jazeera: IRGC Navy said a crude supertanker hit a naval mine on Saturday night while using an unauthorised route

lines.text: Kpler data shows crude flows last week around forty percent below normal.
lines.note: Al Jazeera citing CNBC: Kpler, week ended 7 Oct, 8.5 million barrels per day, roughly 40% below normal

lines.text: Before the war, a fifth of the world's oil and gas passed here.
lines.note: Reuters: the Strait carried about a fifth of the world's oil and LNG before the war

lines.text: Day two hundred and twenty seven tomorrow. Will the strait reopen this month, yes or no?

sources.title: Iran says US response to its proposal to reopen Hormuz was 'insufficient'

caption: Hormuz, Iran, US talks: Iran's security chief Mohsen Rezaei says the US reply to Tehran's seven-condition plan for reopening the Strait of Hormuz is insufficient, and there will be no reopening or talks until the terms are met. Will the strait reopen this month, yes or no?
notes_full: Rezaei statement via Iranian state media on Sunday 11 Oct 2026, first reported by Reuters/Anadolu/Arab News about 16:00 to 17:30 UTC; about 3 to 4 hours old at delivery
Removal-risk: statements made, all attributed; no tolls, no casualties; no future-attack framing; Sayyari's threat quote deliberately not featured; neutral yes/no on reopening
